## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.
Include any design ideas, API shapes, or UI mockups if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Impact

Mark the impact level of this feature:

- [ ] **MVP** — Required for minimum viable product launch
- [ ] **STRETCH** — Important but can wait post-MVP
- [ ] **VISION** — Long-term strategic enhancement

## Dependencies

List any dependencies this feature relies on:

- [ ] External API or service
- [ ] New library or tool
- [ ] Database schema changes
- [ ] Infrastructure changes
- [ ] Other feature/issue: #

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.
